sentences.en: The bank came through with the loan we had requested.
sentences.zh: 银行批准了我们申请的贷款。

sentences.en: May I make so bold as to request your assistance?
sentences.zh: 我是否可以冒昧地请求您的帮助？

sentences.en: She attended the meeting at the request of the chairman.
sentences.zh: 她应主席的要求参加了会议。
